data.name: Sheraton Vitoria Hotel
data.address: Av. Saturnino De Brito Avenue 217 - Praia do Canto, Vitória - ES, 29055-095, Brazil
data.description:
A 6-minute walk from the closest beach, this modern, high-rise hotel sits 3.3 km from the shops at Victoria Mall.
The refined rooms feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, desks and safes, and room service is offered 24/7. Upgraded quarters provide sea views, while executive rooms include iPod docks, tea and coffeemakers, and club lounge access. Club suites add whirlpool tubs, dining areas, and living rooms with pull-out sofas.
A restaurant serves international dishes, and there's also a lobby bar. An indoor pool, a sauna and a fitness room are available, plus a convention center with 7 meeting rooms. Parking is offered for a fee.
